propositions: GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup, creating an ordering deadlock when the readiness gate checks for these fields before project provisioning
The session-start readiness check waits for capabilities that only the blocked action (project creation) can produce, making the wait unreachable regardless of timeout budget

Increasing the readiness timeout from 600s to 1800s did not resolve the issue because the problem is an ordering dependency, not a timing insufficiency, proven by identical field inventories after both timeouts expired
The Epic-field readiness check must be relocated from session-start to immediately after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities to exist at the only moment those fields can be present
The probe script _await_named_fields runs before project creation, replicating the same ordering deadlock seen in the harness
The decision rule in not_ready_message claiming 'no customfield entries means the plugin is still starting' is self-confirming and incorrect for instances with no projects created
